glyph_origin: Possibly a phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 爻 + phonetic 六. Later, 𦥑 was added to form 𦥯, and a semantic 子 (“child”) was added for differentiation. In the modern form, 六 has corrupted to 冖 (“cover”), and the hands 𦥑 around the 爻 have become connected with the 冖. Shuowen regards 𦥑 as the phonetic component in the character, which may be true according to some Old Chinese reconstructions such as that of Pan Wuyun's, though probably not others. See also the top component of 覺, which is a contraction of 學.
shuowen: Shuowen regards 𦥑 as the phonetic component in the character, which may be true according to some Old Chinese reconstructions such as that of Pan Wuyun's, though probably not others.
senses: [xué] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to comprehend; to realise; to understand
[xiào] (obsolete) alternative form of 斆 (“to teach; to instruct; to train”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 學; s_page_origin explains the simplified 学.
